hookups.source: MN DNR Lake Shetek overnight facilities ('There are 32 electric sites in Oak Woods Campground and 32 sites with sewer/water/electricity in Sunrise Campground. All sites with electricity are 20/30/50 amp service.') + ReserveMN facility 802 '32 Drive-In Electric/Water/Sewer' units, read 2026-11-11

values.note: Sunrise: 32 full-hookup sites (50-75 ft). Oak Woods: 31 electric and 6 non-electric drive-in sites (35-120 ft) plus 7 cart-in sites. Prairie: 11 rustic drive-in sites that post 20 ft, too short for a 23-ft rig.

sites.source: ReserveMN grid, 2027-06-15 (802 Sunrise 32 Drive-In Electric/Water/Sewer, VehicleLength 50-75; 804 Oak Woods 31 Drive-In Electric 35-120 + 6 Drive-In 50-55 + 7 Cart-In; 861 Prairie 10 Drive-In + 1 Double Site, all 20) + MN DNR overnight facilities ('RV Length Limit 70 Feet'; Pull-Through Sites '3 pull-through sites with electricity, 1 pull-through site with full hook-up'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Showers in Oak Woods and flush toilets in Oak Woods and Sunrise, open mid-April for the season; vault toilets year-round; in winter, drinking water at the park maintenance shop.

facilities.source: MN DNR Lake Shetek overnight facilities ('Shower buildings are located in Oak Woods Campground and are available to all campers registered in Oak Woods and Sunrise Campgrounds.'; 'Flush toilet buildings are located in the Oak Woods and Sunrise Campgrounds'; Dump Station 'Seasonal') + seasonal update ('Vault toilets are available throughout the park year round.'; 'During the winter months there is drinking water available at the park maintenance shop.'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Oak Woods and Sunrise; Prairie runs April 30 to October 24 (2027). The DNR keeps the campgrounds open in fall 'until the first significant snowfall'.

season.source: ReserveMN grid 2027 (facilities 804 and 802 in season 2027-04-02 to 2027-11-07; 861 Prairie 2027-04-30 to 2027-10-24) + MN DNR seasonal update ('The campgrounds are open for the season and will stay open until the first significant snowfall.'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: $24 a night for a drive-in site without electric, $34 with electric, $42 with full hookups. ReserveMN's prices for June 2027 nights.

fees.source: ReserveMN search/details for every unit of facilities 804, 802 and 861, 2027-06-15 (Oak Woods non-electric 'Rate 24.00', electric '34.00'; Sunrise '42.00'), read 2026-11-11

note: Three drive-in campgrounds near the east shore of Lake Shetek: Sunrise, an open grassy loop, and Oak Woods, in oak forest 70 m or more from the lake, with the small rustic Prairie loop beside them. --Claude
